docs.title: redis-py-kit
docs.text: 企业级 Python Redis 工具库，支持同步/异步双模 API。

docs.title: 功能特性
docs.text: 模块 说明 缓存 Get/Set/Delete、TTL、批量操作、@cached 装饰器、TTL 抖动 多级缓存 L1 本地 LRU + L2 Redis，读穿透，空值缓存（Negative Caching） 分布式锁 基本锁、可重入锁、读写锁、看门狗自动续期 消息队列 PubSub、延迟队列（DelayQueue）、可靠队列（ReliableQueue） Streams 消费者组、自动/手动 ACK、死信恢复 布隆过滤器 SHA-256 多哈希、Pipeline 位操作 计数器 原子 INCR/DECR、有界计数器（BoundCounter）、ID 生成器 Session Redis Hash 会话存储、CRUD、TTL 刷新 限流器 令牌桶、滑动窗口、@rate_limit 装饰器 Repository Dataclass 实体存储、版本控制、软删除、审计、历史记录 可观测性 MetricsCollector、OpenTelemetry 集成

docs.title: 快速安装
docs.text: pip install redis-py-kit

docs.title: 快速示例
docs.text:
from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, Cache

conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice"}, ttl="2h30m")
user = cache.get("user:1")

docs.title: 更新日志
docs.text: 完整版本历史请参阅 GitHub 上的 CHANGELOG.md。

docs.title: 异常层次结构
docs.text:
RedisKitError
├── RedisConnectionError
│   └── ConnectionPoolExhaustedError
├── SerializationError
├── TopologyConstraintError
├── LockError
│   ├── LockAcquireError
│   └── LockReleaseError
├── CacheError
├── QueueError
│   └── QueueEmptyError
├── BloomFilterError
├── SessionError
│   └── SessionNotFoundError
├── RateLimitExceeded
├── StreamError
└── RepositoryError
    ├── EntityNotFoundError
    └── OptimisticLockError

docs.title: 降级策略（FallbackPolicy）
docs.text:
可配置的 Redis 故障降级策略。

from redis_kit import FallbackPolicy, Cache

policy = FallbackPolicy(
    on_connection_error="return_none",  # "raise" | "return_none" | "callback"
    log_on_fallback=True,
)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, fallback_policy=policy)

docs.title: 模式
docs.text: 模式 行为 "raise"（默认） 重新抛出异常 "return_none" 记录警告日志，返回 None "callback" 调用 fallback 回调函数并返回其结果

docs.title: Callback 示例
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, FallbackPolicy

def local_fallback(command: str, key: str, error: Exception):
    """Redis 不可用时从本地缓存降级"""
    if command == "GET":
        return local_cache.get(key)
    return None

policy = FallbackPolicy(
    on_connection_error="callback",
    fallback=local_fallback,
)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", fallback_policy=policy)

仅对连接类异常生效

FallbackPolicy 仅在 RedisConnectionError 和 RedisTimeoutError 时触发。其他异常（如序列化错误）始终直接抛出。

callback 模式必须提供 fallback

使用 on_connection_error="callback" 时，必须同时提供 fallback 回调函数，否则构造时会抛出 ValueError。

docs.title: 序列化器
docs.text:
序列化器 格式 适用场景 JsonSerializer JSON 默认，可读性好，跨语言兼容 PickleSerializer Pickle Python 对象，仅限可信环境 MsgpackSerializer MessagePack 紧凑二进制，速度快（需要 redis-py-kit[msgpack]） 
from redis_kit import Cache, JsonSerializer, PickleSerializer
from redis_kit.serializers import MsgpackSerializer

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, serializer=MsgpackSerializer())

docs.title: 压缩器
docs.text:
压缩器 依赖 特点 ZlibCompressor 无（标准库） 压缩率好，速度适中 ZstdCompressor redis-py-kit[zstd] 最佳压缩率 + 速度 Lz4Compressor redis-py-kit[lz4] 速度最快，压缩率适中 
from redis_kit import ZlibCompressor
from redis_kit.compressors import ZstdCompressor

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, compressor=ZstdCompressor())

docs.title: 组合使用
docs.text:
cache = Cache(
    conn.sync_client,
    prefix="myapp",
    serializer=MsgpackSerializer(),
    compressor=ZstdCompressor(),
)

数据流水线：value → serializer.dumps() → compressor.compress() → Redis

docs.title: 错误处理
docs.text: 所有序列化器在序列化/反序列化失败时统一抛出 SerializationError，并保留原始异常链（from）。无需捕获各底层库的特定异常类型。

docs.title: 拓扑支持
docs.text: 通过更换 Config 对象即可在单机（Standalone）、哨兵（Sentinel）和集群（Cluster）之间切换。

docs.title: 单机模式（默认）
docs.text:
from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, ConnectionConfig

conn = ConnectionManager(config=ConnectionConfig(host="localhost", port=6379))
# or
conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")

url 仅限单机模式

url 参数仅支持 ConnectionConfig（单机模式）。与 SentinelConfig 或 ClusterConfig 同时使用会抛出 ValueError。

docs.title: 哨兵模式（Sentinel）
docs.text:
自动故障转移 —— 上层模块无感知。

from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, SentinelConfig

conn = ConnectionManager(config=SentinelConfig(
    sentinels=[("sentinel1", 26379), ("sentinel2", 26379), ("sentinel3", 26379)],
    service_name="mymaster",
    password="secret",
))

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

docs.title: 集群模式（Cluster）
docs.text:
跨多个主节点进行数据分片。

from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, ClusterConfig, Cache, Lock

conn = ConnectionManager(config=ClusterConfig(
    startup_nodes=[("node1", 6379), ("node2", 6379), ("node3", 6379)],
    password="secret",
    read_from_replicas=True,
))

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache", is_cluster=conn.is_cluster)
lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock", is_cluster=conn.is_cluster)

docs.title: 集群适配
docs.text: 功能 行为 get_many / set_many 自动降级为单条操作 锁的 Key 使用 {hash_tag} 包裹，确保 Lua 脚本的 slot 安全 delete_pattern / iter_keys scan_iter 在所有节点上执行

docs.title: 拓扑检测
docs.text:
conn.topology    # "standalone" | "sentinel" | "cluster"
conn.is_cluster  # bool
conn.is_sentinel # bool

docs.title: 基本安装
docs.text: pip install redis-py-kit

docs.title: 可选依赖
docs.text:
pip install redis-py-kit[msgpack]     # MessagePack serializer
pip install redis-py-kit[zstd]        # Zstandard compressor
pip install redis-py-kit[lz4]         # LZ4 compressor
pip install redis-py-kit[otel]        # OpenTelemetry integration
pip install redis-py-kit[all]         # All optional dependencies

docs.title: 环境要求
docs.text:
• Python >= 3.11
  • Redis >= 7.0
  • redis-py >= 7.4.0

docs.title: 连接
docs.text:
from redis_kit import ConnectionManager

# 通过 URL 连接
conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")

# 通过配置对象连接
from redis_kit import ConnectionConfig
conn = ConnectionManager(config=ConnectionConfig(host="localhost", port=6379, db=0))

docs.title: 缓存
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice"}, ttl="2h30m")
user = cache.get("user:1")

# Cache-aside 模式
user = cache.remember("user:1", factory=load_from_db, ttl=3600)

docs.title: 分布式锁
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Lock

lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock")

with lock("resource-1", timeout=10):
    do_critical_work()

docs.title: 异步用法
docs.text:
每个模块都有对应的异步版本：

from redis_kit import AsyncCache, AsyncLock

cache = AsyncCache(conn.async_client, prefix="myapp:cache")
await cache.set("key", "value", ttl=3600)

docs.title: 布隆过滤器
docs.text: 用于成员检测的概率型数据结构。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import BloomFilter

bf = BloomFilter(conn.sync_client, "emails", expected_items=100_000, false_positive_rate=0.01)

bf.add("alice@example.com")
bf.exists("alice@example.com")   # True
bf.exists("unknown@example.com") # False (probably)

docs.title: 批量操作
docs.text:
bf.add_many(["a@x.com", "b@x.com", "c@x.com"])
results = bf.exists_many(["a@x.com", "d@x.com"])  # [True, False]

docs.title: 重置
docs.text: bf.reset()  # 删除底层 Redis key，清空过滤器

docs.title: 工作原理
docs.text:
• 使用 Double Hashing 技术（基于 SHA-256 的两个基础哈希派生 k 个偏移量），FIPS 兼容
  • 基于 Pipeline 的 SETBIT/GETBIT 操作以提升性能
  • exists_many 使用单次 Pipeline 批量检查，而非 N 次独立调用
  • 根据 expected_items 和 false_positive_rate 自动计算最优位数组大小和哈希函数数量

docs.title: 缓存
docs.text: Redis 缓存，支持序列化、压缩、TTL 抖动和降级策略（FallbackPolicy）。

docs.title: 基本用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, ConnectionManager

conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice"}, ttl="2h30m")
user = cache.get("user:1")
cache.delete("user:1")

docs.title: TTL 管理
docs.text:
cache.set("key", "value", ttl=3600)
cache.ttl("key")          # Remaining seconds
cache.pttl("key")         # Remaining milliseconds
cache.persist("key")      # Remove expiration
cache.expire("key", 600)  # Reset TTL

支持字符串格式的 TTL："2h30m"、"1d"、"30s"。负值会抛出 ValueError。 TTL 字符串必须整体合法，像 "1hfoo" 这类带尾随垃圾内容的值也会抛出 ValueError。

docs.title: Cache-Aside 模式
docs.text: user = cache.remember("user:1", factory=load_from_db, ttl=3600)

docs.title: 批量操作
docs.text:
cache.set_many({"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}, ttl=3600)
values = cache.get_many(["a", "b", "c"])

docs.title: 模式匹配操作（基于 SCAN）
docs.text:
cache.delete_pattern("user:*")
for key in cache.iter_keys("user:*"):
    print(key)

docs.title: 绑定操作（Bound Operations）
docs.text:
user_cache = cache.bind("user:1")
user_cache.set({"name": "Alice"}, ttl=3600)
user_cache.get()
user_cache.ttl()

docs.title: @cached 装饰器
docs.text:
from redis_kit import cached

@cached(conn.sync_client, key="user:{user_id}", ttl="1h")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

# Async (auto-detected)
@cached(conn.async_client, key="product:{pid}", ttl=3600)
async def get_product(pid: int) -> dict:
    return await db.query_product(pid)

docs.title: 错误降级
docs.text:
当 Redis 不可用时，on_error="execute" 可跳过缓存直接执行函数：

@cached(conn.sync_client, key="user:{user_id}", ttl="1h", on_error="execute")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

docs.title: 可调用的 Key/TTL/Bypass
docs.text:
@cached(
    conn.sync_client,
    key=lambda uid: f"user:{uid}",
    ttl=lambda uid: 3600 if uid < 100 else 300,
    bypass=lambda uid, force=False: force,
)
def get_user(uid: int, force: bool = False) -> dict:
    ...

docs.title: 缓存失效
docs.text:
@cached(conn.sync_client, key="user:{user_id}", ttl="1h")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

# 清除特定参数的缓存
get_user.invalidate(user_id=1)

# 异步版本
@cached(conn.async_client, key="product:{pid}", ttl=3600)
async def get_product(pid: int) -> dict:
    return await db.query_product(pid)

await get_product.invalidate(pid=42)

docs.title: 防穿透（None 缓存）
docs.text: cache.set("user:999", None, ttl=60)  # Cache None to prevent penetration

docs.title: 降级策略（FallbackPolicy）
docs.text:
当 Redis 连接失败时，可配置降级策略而非直接抛异常。

from redis_kit import Cache, FallbackPolicy

# 策略 1: 静默降级，返回 None
policy = FallbackPolicy(on_connection_error="return_none")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", fallback_policy=policy)

# 策略 2: 自定义回调
def my_fallback(command, key, error):
    return {"from": "local_cache"}

policy = FallbackPolicy(on_connection_error="callback", fallback=my_fallback)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", fallback_policy=policy)

详细说明参见 异常处理 - 降级策略。

docs.title: Hooks（可观测性）
docs.text:
Cache 的所有操作（get、set、delete、get_many、set_many、delete_pattern）都支持 Hook 生命周期：before → after（成功时）/ error（失败时）。单个 Hook 异常不会中断缓存操作，仅记录错误日志。

from redis_kit import Cache
from redis_kit.observability import OpenTelemetryHook, MetricsCollector

cache = Cache(
    conn.sync_client,
    prefix="myapp",
    hooks=[OpenTelemetryHook(), MetricsCollector()],
)

docs.title: TTL 抖动（防雪崩）
docs.text: cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", ttl_jitter=0.1)  # +/- 10% random TTL

docs.title: 计数器与 ID 生成器
计数器
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Counter

counter = Counter(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:counter")

counter.incr("page_views")
counter.incr("page_views", 5)
counter.decr("page_views")
value = counter.get("page_views")
counter.reset("page_views")

docs.title: 有界计数器（Bound Counter）
docs.text:
pv = counter.bind("page_views")
pv.incr()
pv.get()
pv.reset()

docs.title: ID 生成器
docs.text:
from redis_kit import IDGenerator

id_gen = IDGenerator(conn.sync_client, "order_id", prefix="ORD", padding=8)
new_id = id_gen.next_str()  # "ORD00000001"
new_id = id_gen.next()      # 2 (raw int)

docs.title: 分布式锁
docs.text: 基于 Lua 脚本原子操作的 Redis 分布式锁。

docs.title: 基本锁
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Lock

lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock")

with lock("resource-1", timeout=10):
    do_critical_work()

docs.title: 可重入锁
docs.text:
with lock("resource", timeout=10, reentrant=True):
    with lock("resource", timeout=10, reentrant=True):
        ...  # No deadlock

docs.title: 读写锁
docs.text:
# 读锁支持 blocking_timeout 重试等待
with lock.read("resource", blocking_timeout=5.0):
    data = read_shared_state()

# 写锁支持 auto_renew 自动续期
with lock.write("resource", auto_renew=True):
    update_shared_state()

docs.title: 看门狗自动续期
docs.text:
with lock("resource", timeout=30, auto_renew=True):
    do_long_running_work()  # Lock auto-extends every 10s

docs.title: 集群模式
docs.text:
lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock", is_cluster=conn.is_cluster)
# Keys automatically wrapped in {hash_tag} for Lua script slot safety

docs.title: 异常安全
docs.text:
所有锁的上下文管理器（__call__、read()、write()）都保证不会遮蔽你代码中抛出的原始异常。如果锁释放失败（例如锁已超时过期），而你的代码同时抛出了异常，原始异常将正常传播，释放失败仅记录警告日志。

try:
    with lock("resource", timeout=5):
        raise ValueError("业务逻辑错误")
except ValueError:
    # ValueError 会正常传播，即使锁释放失败也不会被 LockReleaseError 遮蔽
    pass

# 读写锁同样异常安全
try:
    with lock.write("resource", timeout=5):
        raise ValueError("写操作异常")
except ValueError:
    pass  # 原始异常正常传播

在正常退出（无异常）时，如果锁释放失败则会抛出 LockReleaseError。

读写锁为读者优先策略

在高竞争场景下，持续的读操作可能导致写操作饥饿。如果你的场景写操作较频繁，请注意这一设计特性。

docs.title: 异步用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import AsyncLock

async with AsyncLock(conn.async_client, prefix="lock")("resource", timeout=10):
    await do_async_work()

docs.title: MetricsCollector
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, MetricsCollector

metrics = MetricsCollector()
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", hooks=[metrics])

# After operations...
metrics.command_count("GET")
metrics.error_count()              # 总错误数
metrics.error_count(command="GET") # 按命令过滤的错误数
metrics.latency_stats()  # {"count": N, "avg": X, "min": Y, "max": Z}

docs.title: OpenTelemetry
docs.text:
需要安装 pip install redis-py-kit[otel]。

from redis_kit.observability import OpenTelemetryHook

hook = OpenTelemetryHook(service_name="myapp")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, hooks=[hook])
# Every Redis operation creates an OTel span

docs.title: CommandHook 协议
docs.text:
创建自定义 Hook：

class MyHook:
    def before(self, command: str, key: str, args: tuple) -> None: ...
    def after(self, command: str, key: str, result, duration_ms: float) -> None: ...
    def on_error(self, command: str, key: str, error: Exception) -> None: ...

docs.title: CompositeHook
docs.text:
链式组合多个 Hook：

from redis_kit import CompositeHook

hook = CompositeHook(metrics, otel_hook, my_hook)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, hooks=[hook])

docs.title: 消息队列
docs.text: 包含 PubSub、延迟队列（DelayQueue）和可靠队列（ReliableQueue）。

docs.title: PubSub
docs.text:
from redis_kit import PubSub

pubsub = PubSub(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp")
pubsub.publish("events", {"type": "user_created", "id": 1})

def handler(message):
    print(message)

pubsub.subscribe("events", handler)
pubsub.listen()

docs.title: 优雅停止
docs.text:
listen() 支持优雅停止和可配置的轮询超时：

import threading

pubsub = PubSub(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp")
pubsub.subscribe("events", handler)

# 在后台线程中运行
thread = threading.Thread(target=pubsub.listen, kwargs={"timeout": 1.0})
thread.start()

# 需要停止时
pubsub.stop()   # 信号 listen() 在当前轮询周期后退出
thread.join()

# 或者直接关闭（同时停止监听并释放资源）
pubsub.close()

docs.title: 异步处理器
docs.text:
AsyncPubSub 同时支持同步和异步处理器，异步处理器会自动被 await：

from redis_kit import AsyncPubSub

async_pubsub = AsyncPubSub(conn.async_client, prefix="myapp")

async def async_handler(message):
    await save_to_db(message)

await async_pubsub.subscribe("events", async_handler)
await async_pubsub.listen(timeout=1.0)

docs.title: 模式订阅
docs.text: pubsub.psubscribe("events.*", handler)  # 匹配 events.order、events.user 等

docs.title: 延迟队列（Delay Queue）
docs.text:
基于 Sorted Set 的延迟执行队列。

from redis_kit import DelayQueue

dq = DelayQueue(conn.sync_client, "order:timeout")
dq.put({"order_id": 123}, delay=1800)  # Execute in 30 minutes
messages = dq.poll(count=10)            # Get ready messages

docs.title: 可靠队列（Reliable Queue）
docs.text:
基于 List 的队列，使用 LMOVE + ack/nack 机制。

from redis_kit import ReliableQueue

rq = ReliableQueue(conn.sync_client, "tasks")
rq.put({"task": "send_email", "to": "user@example.com"})

msg = rq.get(timeout=5)
try:
    process(msg.data)
    msg.ack()
except Exception:
    msg.nack()  # Return to queue

# 恢复崩溃消费者遗留的消息
recovered = rq.recover_stale(max_items=100)

建议考虑 Redis Streams

对于新项目，建议使用 Redis Streams 代替 ReliableQueue。Streams 提供消费者组、消息持久化和死信恢复等功能。

docs.title: 限流器
docs.text: 基于令牌桶和滑动窗口算法的分布式限流。

docs.title: 令牌桶（Token Bucket）
docs.text:
平滑流量，支持突发容忍。

from redis_kit import TokenBucketLimiter

limiter = TokenBucketLimiter(conn.sync_client, rate=10, capacity=50)
result = limiter.acquire("user:123")

if not result.allowed:
    print(f"Rate limited, retry after {result.retry_after:.1f}s")

docs.title: 滑动窗口（Sliding Window）
docs.text:
在时间窗口内进行严格计数。

from redis_kit import SlidingWindowLimiter

limiter = SlidingWindowLimiter(conn.sync_client, limit=100, window=60)
result = limiter.acquire("user:123")

docs.title: RateLimitResult
docs.text:
result.allowed      # bool
result.limit        # Total limit
result.remaining    # Remaining quota
result.retry_after  # Seconds to wait (if rejected)
result.reset_at     # Window reset timestamp

映射到 HTTP 响应头：X-RateLimit-Limit、X-RateLimit-Remaining、Retry-After、X-RateLimit-Reset。

docs.title: @rate_limit 装饰器
docs.text:
from redis_kit import rate_limit

@rate_limit(conn.sync_client, key="api:{user_id}", limit="100/minute")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

# Token bucket algorithm
@rate_limit(conn.async_client, key="api:{uid}", limit="10/second", algorithm="token_bucket")
async def get_product(uid: int) -> dict:
    return await db.query_product(uid)

支持的 DSL 格式："100/minute"、"10/second"、"1000/hour"、"10000/day"。 DSL 必须完整匹配，algorithm 只支持 "sliding_window" 和 "token_bucket"；非法值会抛出 ValueError。

被拒绝时抛出 RateLimitExceeded 异常，包含 .result 属性。

docs.title: Repository
docs.text: Dataclass 实体存储，支持版本控制、软删除、审计和历史记录。

docs.title: 定义实体
docs.text:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redis_kit import BaseModel

@dataclass
class AppConfig(BaseModel):
    name: str = ""
    value: str = ""
    env: str = "production"

BaseModel 提供以下字段：id、version、created_at、updated_at、deleted、deleted_at。

docs.title: CRUD 操作
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Repository

repo = Repository(conn.sync_client, AppConfig, prefix="config")

# Create — auto ID, version=1, created_at
config = repo.save(AppConfig(name="max_retries", value="3"))

# Read
found = repo.find(config.id)

# Update — auto version increment, updated_at
found.value = "5"
updated = repo.save(found)  # version 1 → 2

# List all
all_configs = repo.find_all()

docs.title: 乐观锁（Optimistic Locking）
docs.text:
stale = repo.find(config.id)    # version=2
updated.value = "10"
repo.save(updated)               # version 2 → 3

stale.value = "20"
repo.save(stale)                  # OptimisticLockError! (expected 2, actual 3)

docs.title: 软删除
docs.text:
repo.delete(config.id)                       # deleted=True, version+1
repo.find(config.id)                         # None
repo.find_including_deleted(config.id)       # Still accessible
restored = repo.restore(config.id)           # Recovered, version+1
repo.hard_delete(config.id)                  # Permanently removed

delete() 和 restore() 都使用乐观锁保证原子性，并自动递增 version、更新 updated_at。

docs.title: 版本历史
docs.text:
history = repo.get_history(config.id)  # save()/delete()/restore() 之前的历史状态
for version in history:
    print(f"v{version.version}: {version.value}")

docs.title: 异步用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import AsyncRepository

repo = AsyncRepository(conn.async_client, AppConfig, prefix="config")
config = await repo.save(AppConfig(name="key", value="val"))
found = await repo.find(config.id)

docs.title: Session 管理
docs.text: 基于 Redis Hash 的会话管理，使用 JSON 序列化保留数据类型。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import SessionManager

sessions = SessionManager(conn.sync_client, prefix="session", ttl=1800)

# 创建
session_id = sessions.create({"user_id": 1, "role": "admin"})

# 读取 — 值保留原始类型（int、list、dict 等）
data = sessions.get(session_id)
assert data["user_id"] == 1  # int，不是 "1"

# 更新（部分更新，同时刷新 TTL）
sessions.update(session_id, {"last_active": "2026-04-10"})

# 刷新 TTL
sessions.refresh(session_id)

# 删除
sessions.delete(session_id)

# 检查是否存在
sessions.exists(session_id)

docs.title: 自定义 ID 生成器
docs.text:
sessions = SessionManager(
    conn.sync_client,
    prefix="session",
    ttl=1800,
    id_generator=lambda: my_custom_id(),
)

docs.title: Redis Streams
docs.text: 基于 Redis Streams 的消费者组抽象。

docs.title: 生产者
docs.text:
from redis_kit import StreamProducer

producer = StreamProducer(conn.sync_client, stream="orders", maxlen=10000)
msg_id = producer.add({"order_id": "123", "status": "created"})
print(producer.len())

docs.title: 消费者 — 自动 ACK
docs.text:
from redis_kit import StreamConsumer

consumer = StreamConsumer(
    conn.sync_client, stream="orders",
    group="processor", consumer_name="worker-1",
    auto_ack=True,
)
consumer.ensure_group()

for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    print(f"{message.id}: {message.data}")
    # Auto-ACK after each iteration

docs.title: 消费者 — 手动 ACK
docs.text:
consumer = StreamConsumer(
    conn.sync_client, stream="orders",
    group="processor", consumer_name="worker-2",
    auto_ack=False,
)
consumer.ensure_group()

for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    try:
        process(message.data)
        message.ack()
    except Exception:
        pass  # Recover via claim_stale later

docs.title: 死信恢复
docs.text:
stale = consumer.claim_stale(min_idle_ms=60000, count=10)
for msg in stale:
    handle_dead_letter(msg)
    msg.ack()

docs.title: 待处理消息
docs.text:
pending = consumer.pending(count=10)
for entry in pending:
    print(f"{entry['id']} idle {entry['idle_ms']}ms, delivered {entry['delivery_count']} times")

docs.title: 异步用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import AsyncStreamProducer, AsyncStreamConsumer

producer = AsyncStreamProducer(conn.async_client, stream="orders")
await producer.add({"order_id": "456"})

consumer = AsyncStreamConsumer(conn.async_client, stream="orders", group="g", consumer_name="w")
await consumer.ensure_group()

# 自动 ACK
async for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    await process(message.data)

# 手动 ACK — 使用 async_ack()
consumer = AsyncStreamConsumer(conn.async_client, stream="orders", group="g", consumer_name="w", auto_ack=False)
await consumer.ensure_group()

async for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    try:
        await process(message.data)
        await message.async_ack()  # 异步环境使用 async_ack()
    except Exception:
        pass

docs.title: 多级缓存
docs.text: 两级缓存架构：L1（本地 LRU）+ L2（Redis），无需额外外部依赖。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, ConnectionManager
from redis_kit.cache import TieredCache

conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")
redis_cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache = TieredCache(
    redis_cache,
    local_maxsize=2000,   # L1 max entries
    local_ttl=30.0,       # L1 TTL (seconds)
    negative_ttl=5.0,     # Cache misses for 5s
)

docs.title: 读取路径
docs.text:
1. 检查 L1（本地缓存）—— 即时响应，无网络开销
  2. 若未命中，检查 L2（Redis）
  3. 若 L2 命中，自动回填 L1
  4. 若两级均未命中，将空值缓存（Negative Cache）写入 L1（防止重复穿透 L2）

docs.title: 写入路径
docs.text:
写穿透（Write-through）：set() 同时写入 L1 和 L2。

cache.set("user:1", data, ttl=3600)   # L1 + L2
user = cache.get("user:1")             # L1 hit

docs.title: 批量操作
docs.text:
get_many 先查询 L1，仅将未命中的 key 发往 L2：

data = cache.get_many(["user:1", "user:2", "user:3"])

docs.title: 本地缓存管理
docs.text:
cache.invalidate_local("user:1")   # Clear one key from L1
cache.clear_local()                 # Clear all L1
print(cache.local_size)             # Current L1 entry count

docs.title: 绑定操作
docs.text:
user = cache.bind("user:1")
user.set(data, ttl=3600)
user.get()
user.delete()

docs.title: 异步用法
docs.text:
from redis_kit.cache import AsyncTieredCache

cache = AsyncTieredCache(async_redis_cache, local_maxsize=2000, local_ttl=30.0)
value = await cache.get("key")

# 绑定操作
user = cache.bind("user:1")
await user.set(data, ttl=3600)
await user.get()

docs.title: redis-py-kit
docs.text: Enterprise-grade Python Redis toolkit with sync/async dual-mode API.

docs.title: Quick Install
docs.text: pip install redis-py-kit

docs.title: Quick Example
docs.text:
from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, Cache

conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice"}, ttl="2h30m")
user = cache.get("user:1")

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: For the complete version history, see CHANGELOG.md on GitHub.

docs.title: Exception Hierarchy
docs.text:
RedisKitError
├── RedisConnectionError
│   └── ConnectionPoolExhaustedError
├── SerializationError
├── TopologyConstraintError
├── LockError
│   ├── LockAcquireError
│   └── LockReleaseError
├── CacheError
├── QueueError
│   └── QueueEmptyError
├── BloomFilterError
├── SessionError
│   └── SessionNotFoundError
├── RateLimitExceeded
├── StreamError
└── RepositoryError
    ├── EntityNotFoundError
    └── OptimisticLockError

docs.title: Fallback Policy
docs.text:
Configurable degradation strategy for Redis failures.

from redis_kit import FallbackPolicy, Cache

policy = FallbackPolicy(
    on_connection_error="return_none",  # "raise" | "return_none" | "callback"
    log_on_fallback=True,
)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, fallback_policy=policy)

docs.title: Modes
docs.text: Mode Behavior "raise" (default) Re-raises the exception "return_none" Logs a warning, returns None "callback" Calls the fallback function and returns its result

docs.title: Callback Example
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, FallbackPolicy

def local_fallback(command: str, key: str, error: Exception):
    """Fall back to local cache when Redis is unavailable"""
    if command == "GET":
        return local_cache.get(key)
    return None

policy = FallbackPolicy(
    on_connection_error="callback",
    fallback=local_fallback,
)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", fallback_policy=policy)

Only triggers for connection errors

FallbackPolicy only activates for RedisConnectionError and RedisTimeoutError. Other exceptions (e.g., serialization errors) are always re-raised.

callback mode requires a fallback

When using on_connection_error="callback", you must provide a fallback callable. Omitting it raises ValueError at construction time.

docs.title: Serializers
docs.text:
Serializer Format Use Case JsonSerializer JSON Default, human-readable, cross-language compatible PickleSerializer Pickle Python objects, trusted environments only MsgpackSerializer MessagePack Compact binary, fast (requires redis-py-kit[msgpack]) 
from redis_kit import Cache, JsonSerializer, PickleSerializer
from redis_kit.serializers import MsgpackSerializer

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, serializer=MsgpackSerializer())

docs.title: Compressors
docs.text:
Compressor Dependency Characteristics ZlibCompressor None (stdlib) Good compression ratio, moderate speed ZstdCompressor redis-py-kit[zstd] Best compression ratio + speed Lz4Compressor redis-py-kit[lz4] Fastest speed, moderate compression ratio 
from redis_kit import ZlibCompressor
from redis_kit.compressors import ZstdCompressor

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, compressor=ZstdCompressor())

docs.title: Combined Usage
docs.text:
cache = Cache(
    conn.sync_client,
    prefix="myapp",
    serializer=MsgpackSerializer(),
    compressor=ZstdCompressor(),
)

Data pipeline: value -> serializer.dumps() -> compressor.compress() -> Redis

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text: All serializers raise SerializationError on serialization/deserialization failures, with the original exception chained via from. No need to catch library-specific exception types.

docs.title: Topology Support
docs.text: Switch between Standalone, Sentinel, and Cluster modes by swapping the config object.

docs.title: Standalone (Default)
docs.text:
from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, ConnectionConfig

conn = ConnectionManager(config=ConnectionConfig(host="localhost", port=6379))
# or
conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")

url is standalone-only

The url parameter is only supported with ConnectionConfig (standalone mode). Passing url with SentinelConfig or ClusterConfig raises ValueError.

docs.title: Sentinel
docs.text:
Automatic failover -- transparent to upper-layer modules.

from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, SentinelConfig

conn = ConnectionManager(config=SentinelConfig(
    sentinels=[("sentinel1", 26379), ("sentinel2", 26379), ("sentinel3", 26379)],
    service_name="mymaster",
    password="secret",
))

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

docs.title: Cluster
docs.text:
Data sharding across multiple master nodes.

from redis_kit import ConnectionManager, ClusterConfig, Cache, Lock

conn = ConnectionManager(config=ClusterConfig(
    startup_nodes=[("node1", 6379), ("node2", 6379), ("node3", 6379)],
    password="secret",
    read_from_replicas=True,
))

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache", is_cluster=conn.is_cluster)
lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock", is_cluster=conn.is_cluster)

docs.title: Cluster Adaptations
docs.text: Feature Behavior get_many / set_many Automatically falls back to single-key operations Lock keys Wrapped in {hash_tag} for Lua script slot safety delete_pattern / iter_keys scan_iter executes across all nodes

docs.title: Topology Detection
docs.text:
conn.topology    # "standalone" | "sentinel" | "cluster"
conn.is_cluster  # bool
conn.is_sentinel # bool

docs.text: pip install redis-py-kit

docs.title: Optional Dependencies
docs.text:
pip install redis-py-kit[msgpack]     # MessagePack serializer
pip install redis-py-kit[zstd]        # Zstandard compressor
pip install redis-py-kit[lz4]         # LZ4 compressor
pip install redis-py-kit[otel]        # OpenTelemetry integration
pip install redis-py-kit[all]         # All optional dependencies

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• Python >= 3.11
  • Redis >= 7.0
  • redis-py >= 7.4.0

docs.title: Connection
docs.text:
from redis_kit import ConnectionManager

# Connect via URL
conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")

# Connect via config object
from redis_kit import ConnectionConfig
conn = ConnectionManager(config=ConnectionConfig(host="localhost", port=6379, db=0))

docs.title: Cache
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache

cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice"}, ttl="2h30m")
user = cache.get("user:1")

# Cache-aside pattern
user = cache.remember("user:1", factory=load_from_db, ttl=3600)

docs.title: Distributed Lock
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Lock

lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock")

with lock("resource-1", timeout=10):
    do_critical_work()

docs.title: Async Usage
docs.text:
Every module has a corresponding async version:

from redis_kit import AsyncCache, AsyncLock

cache = AsyncCache(conn.async_client, prefix="myapp:cache")
await cache.set("key", "value", ttl=3600)

docs.title: Bloom Filter
docs.text: A probabilistic data structure for membership testing.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import BloomFilter

bf = BloomFilter(conn.sync_client, "emails", expected_items=100_000, false_positive_rate=0.01)

bf.add("alice@example.com")
bf.exists("alice@example.com")   # True
bf.exists("unknown@example.com") # False (probably)

docs.title: Batch Operations
docs.text:
bf.add_many(["a@x.com", "b@x.com", "c@x.com"])
results = bf.exists_many(["a@x.com", "d@x.com"])  # [True, False]

docs.title: Reset
docs.text: bf.reset()  # Delete the underlying Redis key, clearing the filter

docs.title: How It Works
docs.text:
• Uses double hashing technique (two SHA-256-based hashes to derive k offsets), FIPS-compatible
  • Pipeline-based SETBIT/GETBIT operations for improved performance
  • exists_many uses a single pipeline batch check instead of N independent calls
  • Automatically calculates optimal bit array size and hash function count based on expected_items and false_positive_rate

docs.title: Cache
docs.text: Redis cache with serialization, compression, TTL jitter, and fallback policy support.

docs.title: Basic Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, ConnectionManager

conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice"}, ttl="2h30m")
user = cache.get("user:1")
cache.delete("user:1")

docs.title: TTL Management
docs.text:
cache.set("key", "value", ttl=3600)
cache.ttl("key")          # Remaining seconds
cache.pttl("key")         # Remaining milliseconds
cache.persist("key")      # Remove expiration
cache.expire("key", 600)  # Reset TTL

Supports string-format TTL: "2h30m", "1d", "30s". Negative values raise ValueError. The full string must be valid; trailing garbage such as "1hfoo" also raises ValueError.

docs.title: Cache-Aside Pattern
docs.text: user = cache.remember("user:1", factory=load_from_db, ttl=3600)

docs.title: Batch Operations
docs.text:
cache.set_many({"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}, ttl=3600)
values = cache.get_many(["a", "b", "c"])

docs.title: Pattern-Based Operations (SCAN-based)
docs.text:
cache.delete_pattern("user:*")
for key in cache.iter_keys("user:*"):
    print(key)

docs.title: Bound Operations
docs.text:
user_cache = cache.bind("user:1")
user_cache.set({"name": "Alice"}, ttl=3600)
user_cache.get()
user_cache.ttl()

docs.title: @cached Decorator
docs.text:
from redis_kit import cached

@cached(conn.sync_client, key="user:{user_id}", ttl="1h")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

# Async (auto-detected)
@cached(conn.async_client, key="product:{pid}", ttl=3600)
async def get_product(pid: int) -> dict:
    return await db.query_product(pid)

docs.title: Error Degradation
docs.text:
When Redis is unavailable, on_error="execute" skips the cache and runs the function directly:

@cached(conn.sync_client, key="user:{user_id}", ttl="1h", on_error="execute")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

docs.title: Callable Key/TTL/Bypass
docs.text:
@cached(
    conn.sync_client,
    key=lambda uid: f"user:{uid}",
    ttl=lambda uid: 3600 if uid < 100 else 300,
    bypass=lambda uid, force=False: force,
)
def get_user(uid: int, force: bool = False) -> dict:
    ...

docs.title: Cache Invalidation
docs.text:
@cached(conn.sync_client, key="user:{user_id}", ttl="1h")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

# Invalidate cache for specific arguments
get_user.invalidate(user_id=1)

# Async version
@cached(conn.async_client, key="product:{pid}", ttl=3600)
async def get_product(pid: int) -> dict:
    return await db.query_product(pid)

await get_product.invalidate(pid=42)

docs.title: Cache Penetration Protection (None Caching)
docs.text: cache.set("user:999", None, ttl=60)  # Cache None to prevent penetration

docs.title: Fallback Policy
docs.text:
Configure degradation strategies for Redis connection failures instead of raising exceptions.

from redis_kit import Cache, FallbackPolicy

# Strategy 1: Silent degradation, return None
policy = FallbackPolicy(on_connection_error="return_none")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", fallback_policy=policy)

# Strategy 2: Custom callback
def my_fallback(command, key, error):
    return {"from": "local_cache"}

policy = FallbackPolicy(on_connection_error="callback", fallback=my_fallback)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", fallback_policy=policy)

See Exception Handling - Fallback Policy for details.

docs.title: Hooks (Observability)
docs.text:
All Cache operations (get, set, delete, get_many, set_many, delete_pattern) support the full hook lifecycle: before → after (on success) / error (on failure). A failing hook will not break the cache operation — errors are logged instead.

from redis_kit import Cache
from redis_kit.observability import OpenTelemetryHook, MetricsCollector

cache = Cache(
    conn.sync_client,
    prefix="myapp",
    hooks=[OpenTelemetryHook(), MetricsCollector()],
)

docs.title: TTL Jitter (Stampede Prevention)
docs.text: cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", ttl_jitter=0.1)  # +/- 10% random TTL

docs.title: Counter
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Counter

counter = Counter(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:counter")

counter.incr("page_views")
counter.incr("page_views", 5)
counter.decr("page_views")
value = counter.get("page_views")
counter.reset("page_views")

docs.title: Bound Counter
docs.text:
pv = counter.bind("page_views")
pv.incr()
pv.get()
pv.reset()

docs.title: ID Generator
docs.text:
from redis_kit import IDGenerator

id_gen = IDGenerator(conn.sync_client, "order_id", prefix="ORD", padding=8)
new_id = id_gen.next_str()  # "ORD00000001"
new_id = id_gen.next()      # 2 (raw int)

docs.title: Distributed Lock
docs.text: Redis distributed lock based on Lua script atomic operations.

docs.title: Basic Lock
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Lock

lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock")

with lock("resource-1", timeout=10):
    do_critical_work()

docs.title: Reentrant Lock
docs.text:
with lock("resource", timeout=10, reentrant=True):
    with lock("resource", timeout=10, reentrant=True):
        ...  # No deadlock

docs.title: Read-Write Lock
docs.text:
# Read lock supports blocking_timeout for retry waiting
with lock.read("resource", blocking_timeout=5.0):
    data = read_shared_state()

# Write lock supports auto_renew for automatic renewal
with lock.write("resource", auto_renew=True):
    update_shared_state()

docs.title: Watchdog Auto-Renewal
docs.text:
with lock("resource", timeout=30, auto_renew=True):
    do_long_running_work()  # Lock auto-extends every 10s

docs.title: Cluster Mode
docs.text:
lock = Lock(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:lock", is_cluster=conn.is_cluster)
# Keys automatically wrapped in {hash_tag} for Lua script slot safety

docs.title: Exception Safety
docs.text:
All lock context managers (__call__, read(), write()) guarantee they will never mask your original exception. If the lock release fails (e.g., lock TTL expired) while your code also raised an exception, the original exception propagates normally, and the release failure is logged as a warning.

try:
    with lock("resource", timeout=5):
        raise ValueError("business logic error")
except ValueError:
    # ValueError propagates normally, even if lock release fails
    pass

# Read-write locks are also exception-safe
try:
    with lock.write("resource", timeout=5):
        raise ValueError("write operation error")
except ValueError:
    pass  # Original exception propagates normally

On clean exit (no exception), a failed release will raise LockReleaseError as expected.

Reader-preference policy

The read-write lock uses a reader-preference strategy. Under high contention, continuous readers may starve writers. Keep this in mind for write-heavy workloads.

docs.title: Async Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import AsyncLock

async with AsyncLock(conn.async_client, prefix="lock")("resource", timeout=10):
    await do_async_work()

docs.title: MetricsCollector
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, MetricsCollector

metrics = MetricsCollector()
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp", hooks=[metrics])

# After operations...
metrics.command_count("GET")
metrics.error_count()              # Total errors
metrics.error_count(command="GET") # Errors for specific command
metrics.latency_stats()  # {"count": N, "avg": X, "min": Y, "max": Z}

docs.title: OpenTelemetry
docs.text:
Requires pip install redis-py-kit[otel].

from redis_kit.observability import OpenTelemetryHook

hook = OpenTelemetryHook(service_name="myapp")
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, hooks=[hook])
# Every Redis operation creates an OTel span

docs.title: CommandHook Protocol
docs.text:
Create custom hooks:

class MyHook:
    def before(self, command: str, key: str, args: tuple) -> None: ...
    def after(self, command: str, key: str, result, duration_ms: float) -> None: ...
    def on_error(self, command: str, key: str, error: Exception) -> None: ...

docs.title: CompositeHook
docs.text:
Chain multiple hooks together:

from redis_kit import CompositeHook

hook = CompositeHook(metrics, otel_hook, my_hook)
cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, hooks=[hook])

docs.title: Message Queue
docs.text: Includes PubSub, DelayQueue, and ReliableQueue.

docs.title: Graceful Shutdown
docs.text:
listen() supports graceful shutdown and configurable poll timeout:

import threading

pubsub = PubSub(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp")
pubsub.subscribe("events", handler)

# Run in a background thread
thread = threading.Thread(target=pubsub.listen, kwargs={"timeout": 1.0})
thread.start()

# When you need to stop
pubsub.stop()   # Signal listen() to exit after current poll cycle
thread.join()

# Or close directly (stops listening and releases resources)
pubsub.close()

docs.title: Async Handlers
docs.text:
AsyncPubSub supports both sync and async handlers. Async handlers are automatically awaited:

from redis_kit import AsyncPubSub

async_pubsub = AsyncPubSub(conn.async_client, prefix="myapp")

async def async_handler(message):
    await save_to_db(message)

await async_pubsub.subscribe("events", async_handler)
await async_pubsub.listen(timeout=1.0)

docs.title: Pattern Subscription
docs.text: pubsub.psubscribe("events.*", handler)  # Matches events.order, events.user, etc.

docs.title: Delay Queue
docs.text:
Delayed execution queue based on Sorted Set.

from redis_kit import DelayQueue

dq = DelayQueue(conn.sync_client, "order:timeout")
dq.put({"order_id": 123}, delay=1800)  # Execute in 30 minutes
messages = dq.poll(count=10)            # Get ready messages

docs.title: Reliable Queue
docs.text:
List-based queue with LMOVE + ack/nack mechanism.

from redis_kit import ReliableQueue

rq = ReliableQueue(conn.sync_client, "tasks")
rq.put({"task": "send_email", "to": "user@example.com"})

msg = rq.get(timeout=5)
try:
    process(msg.data)
    msg.ack()
except Exception:
    msg.nack()  # Return to queue

# Recover messages from crashed consumers
recovered = rq.recover_stale(max_items=100)

Consider Redis Streams

For new projects, consider using Redis Streams instead of ReliableQueue. Streams provide consumer groups, message persistence, and dead-letter recovery.

docs.title: Rate Limiter
docs.text: Distributed rate limiting based on token bucket and sliding window algorithms.

docs.title: Token Bucket
docs.text:
Smooths traffic with burst tolerance.

from redis_kit import TokenBucketLimiter

limiter = TokenBucketLimiter(conn.sync_client, rate=10, capacity=50)
result = limiter.acquire("user:123")

if not result.allowed:
    print(f"Rate limited, retry after {result.retry_after:.1f}s")

docs.title: Sliding Window
docs.text:
Strict counting within a time window.

from redis_kit import SlidingWindowLimiter

limiter = SlidingWindowLimiter(conn.sync_client, limit=100, window=60)
result = limiter.acquire("user:123")

docs.title: RateLimitResult
docs.text:
result.allowed      # bool
result.limit        # Total limit
result.remaining    # Remaining quota
result.retry_after  # Seconds to wait (if rejected)
result.reset_at     # Window reset timestamp

Maps to HTTP response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Reset.

docs.title: @rate_limit Decorator
docs.text:
from redis_kit import rate_limit

@rate_limit(conn.sync_client, key="api:{user_id}", limit="100/minute")
def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict:
    return db.query_user(user_id)

# Token bucket algorithm
@rate_limit(conn.async_client, key="api:{uid}", limit="10/second", algorithm="token_bucket")
async def get_product(uid: int) -> dict:
    return await db.query_product(uid)

Supported DSL formats: "100/minute", "10/second", "1000/hour", "10000/day". The DSL must match completely, and algorithm must be either "sliding_window" or "token_bucket".

Raises RateLimitExceeded exception when rejected, with a .result attribute.

docs.title: Repository
docs.text: Dataclass entity storage with versioning, soft delete, audit, and history.

docs.title: Define an Entity
docs.text:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redis_kit import BaseModel

@dataclass
class AppConfig(BaseModel):
    name: str = ""
    value: str = ""
    env: str = "production"

BaseModel provides the following fields: id, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted, deleted_at.

docs.title: CRUD Operations
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Repository

repo = Repository(conn.sync_client, AppConfig, prefix="config")

# Create — auto ID, version=1, created_at
config = repo.save(AppConfig(name="max_retries", value="3"))

# Read
found = repo.find(config.id)

# Update — auto version increment, updated_at
found.value = "5"
updated = repo.save(found)  # version 1 → 2

# List all
all_configs = repo.find_all()

docs.title: Optimistic Locking
docs.text:
stale = repo.find(config.id)    # version=2
updated.value = "10"
repo.save(updated)               # version 2 → 3

stale.value = "20"
repo.save(stale)                  # OptimisticLockError! (expected 2, actual 3)

docs.title: Soft Delete
docs.text:
repo.delete(config.id)                       # deleted=True, version+1
repo.find(config.id)                         # None
repo.find_including_deleted(config.id)       # Still accessible
restored = repo.restore(config.id)           # Recovered, version+1
repo.hard_delete(config.id)                  # Permanently removed

Both delete() and restore() use optimistic locking for atomicity, automatically incrementing version and updating updated_at.

docs.title: Version History
docs.text:
history = repo.get_history(config.id)  # previous states from save(), delete(), and restore()
for version in history:
    print(f"v{version.version}: {version.value}")

docs.title: Async Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import AsyncRepository

repo = AsyncRepository(conn.async_client, AppConfig, prefix="config")
config = await repo.save(AppConfig(name="key", value="val"))
found = await repo.find(config.id)

docs.title: Session Management
docs.text: Session management based on Redis Hash with JSON serialization to preserve data types.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import SessionManager

sessions = SessionManager(conn.sync_client, prefix="session", ttl=1800)

# Create
session_id = sessions.create({"user_id": 1, "role": "admin"})

# Read — values preserve original types (int, list, dict, etc.)
data = sessions.get(session_id)
assert data["user_id"] == 1  # int, not "1"

# Update (partial update, also refreshes TTL)
sessions.update(session_id, {"last_active": "2026-04-10"})

# Refresh TTL
sessions.refresh(session_id)

# Delete
sessions.delete(session_id)

# Check existence
sessions.exists(session_id)

docs.title: Custom ID Generator
docs.text:
sessions = SessionManager(
    conn.sync_client,
    prefix="session",
    ttl=1800,
    id_generator=lambda: my_custom_id(),
)

docs.title: Redis Streams
docs.text: Consumer group abstraction built on Redis Streams.

docs.title: Producer
docs.text:
from redis_kit import StreamProducer

producer = StreamProducer(conn.sync_client, stream="orders", maxlen=10000)
msg_id = producer.add({"order_id": "123", "status": "created"})
print(producer.len())

docs.title: Consumer -- Auto ACK
docs.text:
from redis_kit import StreamConsumer

consumer = StreamConsumer(
    conn.sync_client, stream="orders",
    group="processor", consumer_name="worker-1",
    auto_ack=True,
)
consumer.ensure_group()

for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    print(f"{message.id}: {message.data}")
    # Auto-ACK after each iteration

docs.title: Consumer -- Manual ACK
docs.text:
consumer = StreamConsumer(
    conn.sync_client, stream="orders",
    group="processor", consumer_name="worker-2",
    auto_ack=False,
)
consumer.ensure_group()

for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    try:
        process(message.data)
        message.ack()
    except Exception:
        pass  # Recover via claim_stale later

docs.title: Dead-Letter Recovery
docs.text:
stale = consumer.claim_stale(min_idle_ms=60000, count=10)
for msg in stale:
    handle_dead_letter(msg)
    msg.ack()

docs.title: Pending Messages
docs.text:
pending = consumer.pending(count=10)
for entry in pending:
    print(f"{entry['id']} idle {entry['idle_ms']}ms, delivered {entry['delivery_count']} times")

docs.title: Async Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import AsyncStreamProducer, AsyncStreamConsumer

producer = AsyncStreamProducer(conn.async_client, stream="orders")
await producer.add({"order_id": "456"})

consumer = AsyncStreamConsumer(conn.async_client, stream="orders", group="g", consumer_name="w")
await consumer.ensure_group()

# Auto ACK
async for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    await process(message.data)

# Manual ACK — use async_ack()
consumer = AsyncStreamConsumer(conn.async_client, stream="orders", group="g", consumer_name="w", auto_ack=False)
await consumer.ensure_group()

async for message in consumer.listen(count=10, block=5000):
    try:
        await process(message.data)
        await message.async_ack()  # Use async_ack() in async context
    except Exception:
        pass

docs.title: Tiered Cache
docs.text: Two-level cache architecture: L1 (local LRU) + L2 (Redis), with no additional external dependencies.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit import Cache, ConnectionManager
from redis_kit.cache import TieredCache

conn = ConnectionManager(url="redis://localhost:6379/0")
redis_cache = Cache(conn.sync_client, prefix="myapp:cache")

cache = TieredCache(
    redis_cache,
    local_maxsize=2000,   # L1 max entries
    local_ttl=30.0,       # L1 TTL (seconds)
    negative_ttl=5.0,     # Cache misses for 5s
)

docs.title: Read Path
docs.text:
1. Check L1 (local cache) -- instant response, no network overhead
  2. If miss, check L2 (Redis)
  3. If L2 hit, auto-backfill L1
  4. If both levels miss, write a negative cache entry to L1 (prevents repeated L2 penetration)

docs.title: Write Path
docs.text:
Write-through: set() writes to both L1 and L2.

cache.set("user:1", data, ttl=3600)   # L1 + L2
user = cache.get("user:1")             # L1 hit

docs.title: Batch Operations
docs.text:
get_many queries L1 first, only sending missed keys to L2:

data = cache.get_many(["user:1", "user:2", "user:3"])

docs.title: Local Cache Management
docs.text:
cache.invalidate_local("user:1")   # Clear one key from L1
cache.clear_local()                 # Clear all L1
print(cache.local_size)             # Current L1 entry count

docs.title: Bound Operations
docs.text:
user = cache.bind("user:1")
user.set(data, ttl=3600)
user.get()
user.delete()

docs.title: Async Usage
docs.text:
from redis_kit.cache import AsyncTieredCache

cache = AsyncTieredCache(async_redis_cache, local_maxsize=2000, local_ttl=30.0)
value = await cache.get("key")

# Bound operations
user = cache.bind("user:1")
await user.set(data, ttl=3600)
await user.get()
